title: Antiphony: A Dual-Process Agent for Deepfake Video Detection with Real-Video Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2611.29999v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable video deepfake detection requires generalization to unseen generators while limiting false alarms on authentic footage. Although existing detectors capture diverse visual cues, they may produce overconfident errors under generator shift, limiting the reliability of confidence-based fusion. Threshold calibration is further complicated by shifts in authentic capture domains and the lack of future-generator examples. To address these challenges, we present Antiphony, a framework that combines calibrated fusion of four visual experts with selective investigation. Authentic videos serve as a shared reference for score fusion and threshold calibration, enabling threshold updates without target deepfakes. For this expert-fusion stage, we establish finite-sample false-alarm control when the scoring procedure is fixed independently of calibration and authentic samples are exchangeable. translated_title: Antiphony：一种基于真实视频校准的深度伪造视频检测双过程智能体
translated_abstract: 可靠的视频深度伪造检测需要在泛化到未见过的生成器的同时，限制对真实视频片段的误报。尽管现有的检测器能够捕捉多样化的视觉线索，但在生成器发生偏移时可能产生过度自信的错误，从而限制了基于置信度的融合的可靠性。由于真实拍摄域的偏移以及缺乏未来生成器的样本，阈值校准变得更加复杂。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Antiphony，这是一个将四个视觉专家的校准融合与选择性调查相结合的框架。真实视频作为分数融合和阈值校准的共享参考，使得无需目标深度伪造样本即可实现阈值更新。对于该专家融合阶段，当评分程序独立于校准过程固定且真实样本满足可交换性时，我们建立了有限样本误报控制。为了在校准阈值附近细化决策，
tldr: 提出Antiphony双过程框架，利用真实视频作为共享参考实现四个视觉专家的校准融合与阈值校准，在无需目标深度伪造样本的情况下实现有限样本误报控制的深度伪造视频检测。
en_tdlr: Antiphony is a dual-process deepfake video detection framework that uses authentic videos as a shared reference for calibrated fusion of four visual experts and threshold calibration, achieving finite-sample false-alarm control without requiring target deepfake examples.
